description: Full-text search over Xianmi Library (显密文库, xianmi.co): ~250k pages of Chinese Buddhist texts (sutras, commentaries, Theravada/Tibetan/Chinese traditions, modern translations). Returns ranked page titles, URLs and snippets. Use get_passage with a returned path to fetch full text. Attribution required: see the license pointer included in every response.

lang.description: Language edition: zh-Hans = Simplified Chinese (default), zh-Hant = Traditional Chinese

page.description: Result page number, 10 per page (default 1, max 1000)

query.description: Search keywords (Chinese or English), e.g. "金刚经" or "四圣谛"

name: search_texts
title: Search Xianmi Buddhist Library
